about: Real hard commands from the 2026-10-03 run (and the night before) that HIL got wrong, with the screen and recent conversation reconstructed in the Mac's observation format, and what the right behaviour is. Scored by scripts/hil-hard-eval.mjs against a live hil-loop endpoint.

cases.pattern: 1 question answered with an action
cases.command: So basically, I can make people post on Instagram using the API?
cases.context:
Front app: Google Chrome
Front tab: Instagram Platform | Developer Documentation https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform
Just before this:
They said: can you please summarize it for me even shorter
You said: Instagram's API lets apps access Instagram features like posts, comments, messages, publishing, insights, and webhooks, depending on the login method and permissions.
cases.screen:
APP: Google Chrome | window: Instagram Platform | Developer Documentation
Address: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform
[0] link      "Overview"
[1] link      "Instagram API with Instagram Login"
[2] link      "Instagram API with Facebook Login"
[3] link      "Content Publishing"
[4] link      "Comment Moderation"
[5] link      "Insights"
[6] link      "Webhooks"
